newsitem.title: USA: MFC Bancorp unit sells remediation business.
newsitem.headline: MFC Bancorp unit sells remediation business.

text.p: MFC Bancorp Ltd said early Monday that its subsidiary, ICHOR Corp, has sold its remaining environmental remediation business to Mcleren Hart Corp for approximately book value.
The company did not disclose the book value, and was not immediately available for comment.

"The sale of the remediation business completes the company's program of exiting the highly competitive environmental remediation industry and will permit management to focus on its strategy of reallocating assets," MFC President Michael Smith said in a statement. "The immediate impact of the sale will be to eliminate overhead and operating losses that ICHOR has experienced with this business."
